verdict.rationale: Claude Code is fundamentally a CLI/agentic terminal and chat-driven tool; the evidence describes plan-then-write, diff review, and IDE integrations (VS Code, JetBrains) but nothing about inline-as-you-type autocomplete or next-edit suggestions like a Copilot-style ghost text feature. Its IDE plugins offer inline diffs and @-mentions, not predictive completions while typing.
